body.name: Synchronizer--two-permutation kill-test handle
body.construction: For the explicitly declared uniform binary-row recursion \(m_t(\lambda,\vartheta)\), apply a two-parameter self-normalized martingale covering with corner-integrable derivative energy to \(\sup_{(\lambda,\vartheta)\in[0,1]^2}|\sum_{t=1}^T m_t(\lambda,\vartheta)|\); if this control fails, search for a horizon-dependent parameter sequence attaining the divergent normalized width.
